data.body: Per /dso:brainstorm of Epic 0777-0f3d (multi-agent coordination primitives), this epic conflicts with the planned removal of write-blackboard.sh and the blackboard infrastructure. Specifically, the proposed 'Blackboard extension — add an interfaces section to the blackboard' approach is incompatible with Epic 0777-0f3d's hard cutover. This epic requires a re-brainstorm after Epic 0777-0f3d closes, ideally reformulating contract declarations as typed events on the tickets branch (e.g., CONTRACT_DECLARATION / CONTRACT_VERIFIED) using Epic 0777-0f3d's event infrastructure. Tracked via cross-epic interaction scan during Epic 0777-0f3d brainstorm.
